name: Lincoln University
description: At Lincoln University, we’ve been leading land and primary industry-based education and research for more than 140 years. We know where our sectors are evolving and the changes we need to make to take care of our natural environment and protect our biodiversity. Equally, we understand the constants: the ever-present, unchanging principles that are essential to a healthy relationship with the land, food, fibre and natural ecosystems.
